name: scrolled
description: Bridge to an open Scrolled browser tab — exposes every map, item, mob, quest, and collection as MCP tools.
long_description: Connects Claude to your Scrolled tab over a localhost WebSocket. Enable External Tools in Scrolled's Settings, then ask Claude about your library — search maps, look up drops, manage collections. Nothing leaves your machine; the browser owns the data and the extension is just a protocol adapter.

port.title: Bridge port
port.description: WebSocket port the Scrolled tab dials. Match the value in Scrolled's Settings → External Tools.

host.title: Bridge host
host.description: Bind address for the WebSocket server.
